alert.vote_similarity_body.text: 本期未執行投票相似度，讀者的投票沒有作用，精選未經過濾就直接發布。嵌入 API 拒絕了請求：HTTP {$status} {$detail}。在嵌入金鑰或其權限修好之前，每次產生精選都會再發生。
alert.vote_similarity_body.source: Vote similarity did not run this period, so reader votes had no effect on this digest. The digest was published unfiltered. The embedding API refused the request: HTTP {$status} {$detail}. This repeats every run until the embedding key or its permissions are fixed.

digest.description.text: Cyris {$issue} 精選：從 {$received} 篇文章選出 {$included} 篇。

error.no_settings_store.text: 這個部署沒有可寫入的設定儲存區
error.no_settings_store.source: this deployment has no settings store to write

feed_check.already_listed.text: 清單中已有這個資訊來源，名稱為「{$name}」。
feed_check.already_listed.source: This feed is already in the list as {$name}.

feed_check.encoded.text: {$url} 回應了未要求的壓縮格式。請貼上資訊來源本身的網址。
feed_check.encoded.source: {$url} answered in a compressed form the check did not ask for. Paste the feed's own address.

feed_check.http_status.text: {$url} 回應 HTTP {$status}。請檢查網址，或改貼資訊來源本身的網址。
feed_check.http_status.source: {$url} answered HTTP {$status}. Check the address, or paste the feed's own address.

feed_check.no_articles.text: 資訊來源 {$url} 尚無文章，目前沒有內容可讀。
feed_check.no_articles.source: The feed at {$url} has no articles, so there is nothing to read from it yet.

feed_check.no_feed_link.text: 頁面 {$url} 未連結任何 RSS 或 Atom 資訊來源。請在網站上找到資訊來源本身的網址並貼上。
feed_check.no_feed_link.source: The page at {$url} links no RSS or Atom feed. Find the feed's own address on the site and paste that.

feed_check.not_a_feed.text: {$url} 不是 RSS 或 Atom 資訊來源。請貼上資訊來源的網址，或有連結資訊來源的網站首頁。
feed_check.not_a_feed.source: {$url} is not an RSS or Atom feed. Paste a feed's address, or a site's home page that links one.

feed_check.not_a_url.text: 請貼上以 http:// 或 https:// 開頭的網址。
feed_check.not_a_url.source: Paste a web address that starts with http:// or https://.

feed_check.not_public.text: {$url} 位於私人或本機網路，檢查不會抓取這類網址。請貼上公開資訊來源的網址。
feed_check.not_public.source: {$url} is on a private or local network, which this check does not fetch. Paste a public feed's address.

feed_check.too_large.text: {$url} 回應的內容過大，不可能是資訊來源。請貼上資訊來源本身的網址。
feed_check.too_large.source: The answer from {$url} is too large to be a feed. Paste the feed's own address.

feed_check.too_many_redirects.text: {$url} 重新導向次數過多。請貼上資訊來源本身的網址。
feed_check.too_many_redirects.source: {$url} redirects too many times. Paste the feed's own address.

feed_check.unreachable.text: 無法連線到 {$url}（{$reason}）。請檢查網址後再試一次。
feed_check.unreachable.source: Could not reach {$url} ({$reason}). Check the address and try again.

index.description.text: Cyris 精選的所有期數，每期從 RSS 和電子報挑出值得讀的文章，由新到舊排列。
index.description.source: Every issue of a Cyris digest: the articles worth reading from a set of RSS feeds and newsletters, newest first.

index.empty.text: 還沒有任何一期精選。執行 {#code}cyris run{/code} 產生第一期。
index.empty.source: No digests yet. Run {#code}cyris run{/code} to generate your first digest.

index.interest.text: 到{#link}興趣地圖{/link}看你投票過的標籤。
index.interest.source: See the {#link}Interest map{/link} of the tags you vote on.

index.intro.text: Cyris 從 RSS 和電子報收集文章，挑出值得讀的編成精選，由新到舊排列。每一期包含精選，以及這期評選過的所有文章。
index.intro.source: Cyris collects articles from RSS feeds and newsletters and selects the ones worth reading into a digest. Newest first. Each issue has the digest and the full list of articles it judged.

interest.description.text: 你在 Cyris 投票過的文章所帶的標籤。一起出現的標籤會連成線，並標出每項沒興趣標記還剩多少時間。
interest.description.source: The tags of the articles you voted on in Cyris, joined where they appear together, with how much of each suppression clock is left.

interest.empty.text: 你投票過的文章都還沒有標籤。請在投票後執行 {#code}cyris run{/code}。
interest.empty.source: No voted article carries a tag yet. Run {#code}cyris run{/code} after you vote on articles.

interest.failed.source: Could not draw the interest map: {$reason}

interest.holds_elsewhere.text: 目前有標為沒興趣的文章，但都不在這張地圖的標籤附近。
interest.holds_elsewhere.source: Suppressions are active, but none is near a tag on this map.

interest.intro.text: 你投票過的文章所帶的標籤，一起出現的標籤會連成線。
interest.intro.source: The tags of the articles you voted on, joined where they appear together.

interest.legend.text: 亮：標為沒興趣；越暗：剩餘時間越少；淡色：未標為沒興趣。
interest.legend.source: Lit = suppressed now; dimmer = less time left; half colour = not suppressed.

interest.no_holds.text: 目前沒有標為沒興趣的文章。

interest.no_store.text: 興趣地圖要從 SQL 儲存區讀取投票和沒興趣標記，但本站的 [store] backend 不是 "sqlite" 也不是 "d1"。
interest.no_store.source: The interest map reads votes and holds from the SQL store: this deployment's [store] backend is neither "sqlite" nor "d1".

issue.degraded.text: 本期有些步驟無法使用設定的 LLM，部分或全部內容沒有評分，或只有原文摘錄。請到「設定」檢查供應商和金鑰。
issue.degraded.source: Some or all of this issue is unscored or plain excerpts: the configured LLM could not be used for every step this run. Check the provider and its key on Settings.

issue.empty.text: 本期沒有內容：收到的 {$received} 篇文章評選後一篇都沒留下。

issue.empty_raw.text: 本期沒有內容：收到的 {$received} 篇文章評選後一篇都沒留下。可在{#link}所有文章{/link}查看每一篇的評選結果。

issue.generated_by.text: 由 {#link}Cyris{/link} 產生 · {$tokens} 個 token · {$calls} 次 API 呼叫

labels.access_not_set_up.text: 本站還沒設定 Access。請管理員完成 Cloudflare Access 設定後，重新載入頁面。
labels.access_not_set_up.source: Access is not set up for this deployment. Ask the operator to finish the Cloudflare Access setup, then reload the page.

labels.all_answered.text: 每一篇都已回答。請執行 cyris labels report 查看結果。
labels.all_answered.source: Every item is answered. Run cyris labels report for the result.

labels.hint.text: 往左滑選少看，往右滑選多看。點一下卡片，會在新分頁開啟文章。
labels.hint.source: Swipe left for down, right for up. Tap the card to open the article in a new tab.

labels.lede.text: 每張卡片是一篇評選過的文章，但不顯示評選結果。想看更多類似文章就選「多看」，否則選「少看」。
labels.lede.source: Each card is an article the filter judged, without its verdict. Up if you want articles like it, down if not.

labels.not_drawn.text: 尚未抽樣。請先執行 cyris labels draw。
labels.not_drawn.source: No sample is drawn yet. Run cyris labels draw first.

labels.page_description.text: Cyris 盲標：一次顯示一篇抽樣文章，不附評選結果。
labels.page_description.source: Blind labels for a Cyris deployment: one sampled article at a time, without the pipeline's verdict.

labels.progress.text: 已回答 {$answered}／{$total} 篇 · 還剩 {$remaining} 篇

labels.signed_out.text: 登入已過期，回答未記錄。請重新載入頁面並再次登入。
labels.signed_out.source: Your session has ended, so the answer was not taken. Reload the page and sign in again.

labels.unanswered.text: 伺服器沒有回應，回答可能未記錄。請檢查網路連線後再試一次。
labels.unanswered.source: No answer from the server, so the answer may not have been taken. Check your connection, then try again.

mail.empty_raw_at.text: 本期沒有內容：收到的 {$received} 篇文章評選後一篇都沒留下。每一篇的評選結果見「所有文章」：{$url}

mail.footer_links.text: {#archive}過往精選{/archive} · {#settings}設定{/settings}（本信寄到「設定」裡填寫的信箱）
mail.footer_links.source: {#archive}Archive{/archive} · {#settings}Settings{/settings} — mail goes to the address set on Settings

mail.generated_by_cost.text: 由 {#link}Cyris{/link} 產生 · {$tokens} 個 token · {$calls} 次 API 呼叫 · 費用 ${$cost}
mail.generated_by_cost.source: Generated by {#link}Cyris{/link} · {$tokens} tokens · {$calls} api calls · cost ${$cost}

mail.kept.text: 從 {$sources} 個來源的 {$received} 篇文章中收錄 {$included} 篇。

mail.publish_failed.text: 線上版發布失敗，本期沒有網頁可以開啟。
mail.publish_failed.source: Publishing the online edition failed, so this issue has no page to open.

mail.publish_failed_text.text: 線上版發布失敗，本期沒有連結。
mail.publish_failed_text.source: Publishing the online edition failed, so this issue has no link.

mail.stats.text: {$sources} 個來源 · 收到 {$received} 篇 · {#b}收錄 {$included} 篇{/b}

notify.degraded.text: 精選品質下降：本期無法使用設定的 LLM，部分或全部內容沒有評分，或只有原文摘錄。
notify.degraded.source: Degraded digest: the configured LLM could not be used this run, so some or all of it is unscored or plain excerpts.

notify.degraded_model.text: 精選品質下降：本期有些步驟無法使用 LLM {$model}，部分或全部內容沒有評分，或只有原文摘錄。
notify.degraded_model.source: Degraded digest: LLM {$model} could not be used for every step this run, so some or all of it is unscored or plain excerpts.

notify.link_health.text: 抓到 {$synthetic} 封找不到原文連結的電子報；精選中有 {$dead} 則沒有可點的連結

onboarding.added.text: 已新增 {$count} 個資訊來源：{$names}。{$note}

onboarding.added_some.text:
.input {$failed :integer}
{{已新增 {$added}／{$picked} 個資訊來源，以下未新增：}}

onboarding.added_some_next.text: 按「下一步」重試，或按「略過」不加入這些資訊來源，直接繼續。
onboarding.added_some_next.source: Press Next to try again, or Skip to go on without them.

onboarding.advanced.text: 進階：嵌入模型、精選與流程（顯示預設值）
onboarding.advanced.source: Advanced: embedder, digest and pipeline, defaults shown

onboarding.building.text: 正在產生第一期：已經過 {$elapsed}，通常需要幾分鐘。可以按「完成」離開，本期仍會出現在過往精選。
onboarding.building.source: Building the first issue: {$elapsed} so far. It usually takes a few minutes. You can leave with Finish: the issue still reaches the archive.

onboarding.cards_empty.text: 這 {$count} 個資訊來源沒有抓到文章：{$names}。它們仍保留在來源中，第一期會再讀取一次；請到「設定」的「來源」檢查。

onboarding.cards_failed.text: {$reason} 請按「略過」不投票直接繼續，或重新載入頁面再試一次。
onboarding.cards_failed.source: {$reason} Press Skip to go on without votes, or reload the page to try again.

onboarding.cards_no_sources.text: 尚無可抽取文章的資訊來源。請按「上一步」挑選，或按「下一步」繼續。
onboarding.cards_no_sources.source: There are no feeds to draw from yet. Press Back to pick some, or Next to go on.

onboarding.cards_none.text: 目前沒有可投票的文章。沒有投票也能產生第一期，請按「下一步」繼續。
onboarding.cards_none.source: There is no article to vote on yet. Press Next to go on: the first issue works without votes.

onboarding.cards_poll_failed.text: 剛才無法抓取資訊來源（{$reason}），這些卡片只來自之前抓到的文章。
onboarding.cards_poll_failed.source: The feeds could not be fetched just now ({$reason}), so these cards are only what had been fetched before.

onboarding.clef_needs.text: Clef 需要 Workers AI 權杖，請設定 CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID 和 CLOUDFLARE_AI_TOKEN（或 CLOUDFLARE_EMBEDDING_API_TOKEN）。
onboarding.clef_needs.source: Clef needs a Workers AI token: set CLOUDFLARE_ACCOUNT_ID and CLOUDFLARE_AI_TOKEN (or CLOUDFLARE_EMBEDDING_API_TOKEN).

onboarding.discord_webhook_help.text: 請貼上完整網址，Discord 確認網址存在後才會儲存。
onboarding.discord_webhook_help.source: Paste the whole URL; it is saved once Discord confirms it exists.

onboarding.email_from_help.text: 請填寫 Email Routing 網域上的地址。
onboarding.email_from_help.source: An address on your Email Routing domain.

onboarding.email_to_help.text: 留空就不寄信。必須是 Cloudflare Email Routing 中已驗證的收件地址，測試信寄達後才會儲存。
onboarding.email_to_help.source: Leave it empty to send no mail. It must be a verified destination in Cloudflare Email Routing, and is saved once a test message reaches it.

onboarding.email_to_needed.source: Enter the address the digest is sent to, too.

onboarding.embedding_model_help.text: 開啟投票相似度時，會實際呼叫一次來檢查。
onboarding.embedding_model_help.source: Checked with one real call when vote similarity is on.

onboarding.embedding_provider_help.text: 投票相似度用這個嵌入模型比對文章。相似度門檻由模型決定，不在這裡設定。
onboarding.embedding_provider_help.source: The embedder vote similarity compares articles with. Its similarity cutoff comes with the model, so it is not set here.

onboarding.feeds_load_failed.text: 無法載入資訊來源清單：{$reason}。請重新載入頁面再試一次。
onboarding.feeds_load_failed.source: Could not load the feed list: {$reason}. Reload the page to try again.

onboarding.fetching_cards.text: 正在從資訊來源抓取最新文章，可能需要一兩分鐘…
onboarding.fetching_cards.source: Fetching the latest articles from your feeds. This can take a minute or two…

onboarding.first_issue_lede.text: 現在就用你的資訊來源和投票產生一期精選，不必等到下一個發布時間。產生方式和排定的精選相同，也會發送通知；按「略過」則讓第一期在那個時間產生。
onboarding.first_issue_lede.source: Build an issue now from your feeds and votes, instead of waiting for the next publish hour. It runs as a scheduled issue does, notifications included, and Skip leaves the first issue to that hour.

onboarding.gone.text: 已不在資訊來源中 · 未記錄
onboarding.gone.source: No longer in the feed · not recorded

onboarding.hours_help.text: 填入 0 到 23 的整點，以上一步的時區為準；不接受半點。
onboarding.hours_help.source: Whole hours from 0 to 23, in the timezone of the step before; half hours are refused.

onboarding.intro.text: 完成七個步驟，就能產生第一期。每一步都可以略過，略過的步驟會保留目前的值；這裡的所有設定之後都能在「設定」修改。
onboarding.intro.source: Seven steps to your first issue. Skip any of them: a skipped step keeps its current value, and everything here can be changed later in Settings.

onboarding.issue_built.text: 第一期已產生。本站不發布線上版，第一期只會透過通知送達。
onboarding.issue_built.source: Your first issue is built. This deployment publishes no site, so it reached you only through its notifications.

onboarding.issue_published.text: 第一期已發布。{#read}閱讀本期{/read}，或到{#archive}過往精選{/archive}查看它和之後的每一期。
onboarding.issue_published.source: Your first issue is published. {#read}Read it{/read}, or find it with every later issue in the {#archive}archive{/archive}.

onboarding.kept.text: 已勾選，但不在所選主題

onboarding.language_lede.text: 每期精選使用的語言，以及發布時間採用的時區。
onboarding.language_lede.source: The language each issue is written in, and the clock its publish hours are read in.

onboarding.max_articles_help.text: 每期從所有來源中，依發布時間取時間範圍內最新的幾篇文章，評分後編入精選。
onboarding.max_articles_help.source: How many of the window's newest articles, by publish time, one run scores and digests across all sources.

onboarding.model_hint_check.text: 按「下一步」會先實際呼叫供應商一次，打錯字會直接在這裡擋下。
onboarding.model_hint_check.source: Next makes one real call to the provider first, so a typo is refused here.

onboarding.model_hint_none.text: 不呼叫任何模型，精選只列出原文摘錄。
onboarding.model_hint_none.source: No model is called: digests list plain excerpts.

onboarding.model_hint_pick.text: 請選擇有金鑰的供應商。
onboarding.model_hint_pick.source: Pick a provider whose key is present.

onboarding.model_lede.text: 選擇撰寫標題和摘要的模型，供應商限這台機器有金鑰的。金鑰只存在 .env，不會存在這裡。
onboarding.model_lede.source: The model that writes headlines and summaries, from the providers this machine has a key for. Keys stay in .env, never here.

onboarding.no_key.text: 這裡沒有任何供應商的金鑰。請在 .env 設定 {$variables} 其中之一，再重新啟動：compose 安裝請執行 docker compose up -d --force-recreate，uv 安裝請重新執行 cyris triage-ui。或維持「不使用」。
onboarding.no_key.source: No provider has its key here. Set one of {$variables} in .env, then restart: under compose run docker compose up -d --force-recreate, under uv start cyris triage-ui again. Or keep None.

onboarding.no_reason.text: cyris 回應 {$status}，但未說明原因。請再試一次；如果持續失敗，請查看伺服器日誌。
onboarding.no_reason.source: cyris answered {$status} without saying why. Try again; if it keeps failing, check the server log.

onboarding.no_reason_reload.text: cyris 回應 {$status}，但未說明原因。請重新載入頁面再試一次；如果持續失敗，請查看伺服器日誌。
onboarding.no_reason_reload.source: cyris answered {$status} without saying why. Reload the page to try again; if it keeps failing, check the server log.

onboarding.notify_lede.text: 每期精選完成後通知的管道。兩個都留空就不通知。
onboarding.notify_lede.source: Where a finished issue is announced. Leave both empty to be notified nowhere.

onboarding.opening_claim.text: 資訊太多、太快。我先幫你接住；什麼重要，由{#em}你{/em}決定。
onboarding.opening_claim.source: Too much, too fast. I’ll hold it for you; {#em}you{/em} say what matters.

onboarding.output_language_help.text: 標題和摘要使用的語言。
onboarding.output_language_help.source: The language headlines and summaries are written in.

onboarding.own_added.text: 「{$name}」已列在「你的資訊來源」並勾選，按「下一步」會和其他資訊來源一起新增。
onboarding.own_added.source: {$name} is under Your feeds, checked: Next adds it with the others.

onboarding.own_feed_help.text: 貼上資訊來源的網址，或有連結資訊來源的網站首頁。名稱會採用資訊來源本身的標題。
onboarding.own_feed_help.source: A feed's address, or a site's home page that links one. It is named by the feed's own title.

onboarding.own_listed.source: {$name} is already listed, and is checked there.

onboarding.page_description.text: 引導你設定新的 Cyris：語言、發布時間、來源、投票、通知、模型和第一期。
onboarding.page_description.source: The guided setup of a new Cyris deployment: language, publish hours, sources, votes, notifications, the model and the first issue.

onboarding.paste_first.text: 請先貼上資訊來源的網址或網站首頁。
onboarding.paste_first.source: Paste a feed's address, or a site's home page, first.

onboarding.pick_provider.text: 請選擇有金鑰的供應商，或選擇「不使用」。
onboarding.pick_provider.source: Pick a provider whose key is present, or None.

onboarding.picked.text: 已勾選 {$count} 個資訊來源。

onboarding.picked_slow.text: 「投票」步驟會先抓取每個勾選的資訊來源，再發出卡片：{$slow} 個以內約需一分鐘，超過會更久。
onboarding.picked_slow.source: The Votes step fetches every picked feed before it deals cards: up to {$slow} take about a minute, and more take longer.

onboarding.plan_no_sources.text: 尚未加入任何來源，無法產生精選。請按「上一步」挑選，或按「完成」，之後再到「設定」的「來源」新增。
onboarding.plan_no_sources.source: There are no sources yet, so there is nothing to build an issue from. Press Back to pick some, or Finish and add them later under Sources in Settings.

onboarding.plan_published.text: 最近一個發布時間的精選（{$date}）已發布，現在產生會取代它。請到過往精選閱讀。
onboarding.plan_published.source: The issue of the latest publish hour, dated {$date}, is already published, and one built now would replace it. Read it in the archive.

onboarding.plan_started.text: 已從這個頁面開始產生第一期。
onboarding.plan_started.source: The first issue was started from this page.

onboarding.plan_today.text: 按「產生第一期」會立即開始，需要幾分鐘；今天稍後的精選不會取代它。
onboarding.plan_today.source: Start builds the first issue now. It takes a few minutes, and no later issue today replaces it.

onboarding.plan_yesterday.text: 今天的發布時間 {$hours}（{$timezone}）都還沒到，屆時產生的精選會取代今天日期那一期；按「產生第一期」會立即開始，日期記為昨天，需要幾分鐘。
onboarding.plan_yesterday.source: Start builds the first issue now, dated yesterday: neither of today's publish hours, {$hours} {$timezone}, has begun, and an issue dated today would be replaced by them. It takes a few minutes.

onboarding.preference_source_help.text: 決定哪些項目排在前面：依你的主題投票，或由 Clef 參考與各項目最相近的投票。Clef 無法完整評分的那一期，會改用你的主題投票。
onboarding.preference_source_help.source: Who decides which items come first: your topic votes, or Clef reading the votes nearest each item. An issue Clef cannot fully score uses your topic votes.

onboarding.rank_by_preference_help.text: 把你投多看的主題，以及與它們同名的主題排在前面。排序只會調整順序，不會因此移除任何項目。
onboarding.rank_by_preference_help.source: Put first the items on topics you voted up, and on topics that share a name with them. The order only moves items; nothing is left out for it.

onboarding.recorded_votes.text: 已記錄 {$count} 票：多看 {$up} 票，少看 {$down} 票。

onboarding.run_error.text: 發生錯誤，精選產生中止。
onboarding.run_error.source: The run stopped with an error.

onboarding.run_failed_next.text: 無論如何，下一個發布時間都會產生新的一期。請按「再試一次」，或按「完成」離開。
onboarding.run_failed_next.source: Press Try again, or Finish to leave: the next publish hour brings an issue either way.

onboarding.run_no_articles.text: 在本期讀取的時間範圍內，你的資訊來源都沒有文章。
onboarding.run_no_articles.source: None of your feeds had an article in the window the run reads.

onboarding.run_no_pending.text: 時間範圍內的文章都已評選過，本期沒有新內容。
onboarding.run_no_pending.source: Every article in the window was already decided, so the run had nothing new.

onboarding.run_publish_failed.text: 精選已產生，但發布到過往精選失敗。
onboarding.run_publish_failed.source: The issue was built, but publishing it to the archive failed.

onboarding.run_timed_out.text: {$minutes} 分鐘內沒有任何精選產生完成，本期可能未開始產生，或未留下執行紀錄就中止。請到 app Worker 的日誌查看。
onboarding.run_timed_out.source: No run has ended in {$minutes} minutes, so this one did not start or stopped without a record. Its log is in the app Worker's logs.

onboarding.saved_advanced.text: 進階：已儲存 {$count} 項設定。{$note}

onboarding.schedule_lede.text: 每天兩期精選的發布時間。
onboarding.schedule_lede.source: When each day's two issues are published.

onboarding.session_expired.text: 登入已過期。請重新載入頁面並再次登入。
onboarding.session_expired.source: Your session has expired. Reload the page to sign in again.

onboarding.settings_load_failed.text: 無法載入設定：{$reason}。請重新載入頁面再試一次。
onboarding.settings_load_failed.source: Could not load settings: {$reason}. Reload the page to try again.

onboarding.settings_not_loaded.text: 設定未載入。請重新載入頁面。
onboarding.settings_not_loaded.source: The settings did not load. Reload the page.

onboarding.snippet_help.text: 模型在各步驟讀取每篇文章的長度；讀得越多，每次呼叫的費用越高。
onboarding.snippet_help.source: How much of each article the model reads at each step; more costs more per call.

onboarding.sources_feeds_lede.text: 以下是所選主題的資訊來源。請勾選你會讀的；按「上一步」可以更改主題。
onboarding.sources_feeds_lede.source: The feeds of the topics you picked. Check the ones you read; Back changes the topics.

onboarding.sources_had.text: 本站已有來源。之後可以到「設定」的「來源」新增更多；按「下一步」繼續。
onboarding.sources_had.source: This deployment already has sources. Add more later under Sources in Settings; Next moves on.

onboarding.sources_topics_lede.text: 本站要讀取的資訊來源，每個都由發布者自己提供。請選擇你關注的主題，按「下一步」會列出這些主題的資訊來源。
onboarding.sources_topics_lede.source: The feeds this deployment reads, each a publisher's own feed. Pick the topics you follow; Next shows their feeds.

onboarding.style_prompt_help.text: 用自己的話描述摘要的語氣或重點；留空表示不指定。
onboarding.style_prompt_help.source: Your tone or focus for the summaries, in your own words; empty means none.

onboarding.summarize_follow_help.text: 為你關注的來源中每篇文章加上簡短說明，如同精讀文章。關閉時顯示文章本身的開頭。
onboarding.summarize_follow_help.source: Give each article from a source you follow a short explanation of what it is, as read articles get. Off shows the start of its own text.

onboarding.timezone_detected.text: 從這個瀏覽器偵測到，尚未儲存；按「下一步」會儲存。
onboarding.timezone_detected.source: Detected from this browser, and not saved yet: Next saves it.

onboarding.timezone_help.source: The clock the publish hours are read in.

onboarding.top_story_score_help.text: 同一主題有兩篇以上文章達到這個分數時，會一起列為頭條。
onboarding.top_story_score_help.source: Two or more articles on one topic scoring at least this share the Top story.

onboarding.topic_lifetime_help.text: 在這個天數內出現過的主題算是現行主題，新文章可以加入；許多主題共用一個名稱時，這個名稱在排序中份量較低。投多看會讓主題較慢離開可加入清單；此效果隨投票半衰期減弱，最長不超過主題最後出現後此天數的三倍。
onboarding.topic_lifetime_help.source: Topics seen within this many days are current: new articles can join them, and a name many of them share counts for less in the order. An upvote slows how fast a topic leaves the list new articles can join; the effect fades with the vote half-life, and never lasts past three times this many days after the topic last appeared.

onboarding.topics_hint.text: 選擇主題，查看其資訊來源。若一個都不選就按「下一步」，會直接前往新增自己的資訊來源。
onboarding.topics_hint.source: Pick topics to see their feeds. Next with none picked goes straight to adding your own feed.

onboarding.type_scale_help.text: 每個頁面的文字大小。一分鐘內生效，已發布的精選也適用。
onboarding.type_scale_help.source: How large the text is on every page. It applies within a minute, to issues already published too.

onboarding.unreachable.text: 無法連線到 cyris（{$reason}）。請檢查網路連線後再試一次。
onboarding.unreachable.source: Could not reach cyris ({$reason}). Check the connection and try again.

onboarding.vote_half_life_help.text: 每一票經過這個天數後，權重只剩一半；除非再次投票，偏好會逐漸淡去。
onboarding.vote_half_life_help.source: A vote counts half as much after this many days, so a preference fades unless you vote again.

onboarding.vote_seeds_help.text: 每期比對時，多看和少看各取你最近的幾票。
onboarding.vote_seeds_help.source: How many of your most recent votes on each side a run compares against.

onboarding.vote_similarity_off.text: 投票相似度仍未開啟，投票暫時沒有作用：{$reason} 請到「設定」的「模型」開啟。
onboarding.vote_similarity_off.source: Vote similarity is still off, so votes have no effect yet: {$reason} Turn it on under Model in Settings.

onboarding.votes_gone.text: 發卡片後已有 {$count} 篇文章離開資訊來源，這些票未記錄。

onboarding.votes_lede.text: 以下是資訊來源中幾篇較舊的文章：請標出會讀和不會讀的，其餘不用管。按「下一步」會把每個標記記為一票，第一期就不會收錄這些文章。
onboarding.votes_lede.source: A few older articles from your feeds: mark the ones you would read and the ones you would not, and leave the rest. Next records each mark as a vote, so the first issue leaves those articles out.

onboarding.window_hours_help.text: 每期往回找多久以內的文章。
onboarding.window_hours_help.source: How far back a run looks for articles.

raw.description.text: Cyris {$issue} 精選評選過的所有文章，依來源分組。
raw.description.source: Every article the {$issue} issue of a Cyris digest judged, grouped by source.

raw.hint.text: 往左滑選少看，往右滑選多看；選取卡片後，也可以按 ← 或 →。點一下卡片，會在新分頁開啟文章。
raw.hint.source: Swipe left for down, right for up; with the card focused, ← and → do the same. Tap the card to open the article in a new tab.

raw.intro.text: 本期評選過的所有文章，加上還待定的。精選只挑出其中一部分。
raw.intro.source: Everything the run decided on, plus what is still pending. The digest shows a selection of it.

raw.label.text: 所有文章 · {$articles} 篇 · {$sources} 個來源

vote.access_not_set_up.text: 本站還沒設定 Access。請管理員完成 Cloudflare Access 設定後，重新載入頁面。
vote.access_not_set_up.source: Access is not set up for this deployment. Ask the operator to finish the Cloudflare Access setup, then reload the page.

vote.not_configured.text: 目前無法投票：app Worker 未設定 CYRIS_PROMOTE_WORKER_URL。設定後請再投一次。
vote.not_configured.source: Voting is not set up here: the app Worker has no CYRIS_PROMOTE_WORKER_URL. Set it, then vote again.

vote.refused.text: 投票失敗（HTTP {$status}），請再試一次。如果持續失敗，請檢查 promote Worker。
vote.refused.source: The vote did not go through (HTTP {$status}). Try again; if it keeps failing, check the promote Worker.

vote.signed_out.text: 登入已過期，這次投票沒有記錄。請重新載入頁面並再次登入。
vote.signed_out.source: Your session has ended, so the vote was not taken. Reload the page and sign in again.

vote.unanswered.text: 伺服器沒有回應，投票可能沒有記錄。請檢查網路連線後再試一次。
vote.unanswered.source: No answer from the server, so the vote may not have been taken. Check your connection, then try again.
